title: Betterleaks Cloud Output
description: Findings emitted by the upstream betterleaks scanner. Each dataset record is a Finding struct from betterleaks's JSON report (RuleID, Secret, Match, Fragment with source info, Attributes, optional ValidationStatus when --validation is on).

findings.title: Findings
findings.description: Default dataset. One record per detected secret. Filter by ValidationStatus=valid to see only live, exploitable credentials when validation was enabled.

log.title: Run Log
log.description: Full betterleaks scan log including subprocess stdout/stderr.
